INSERT INTO premium_products ( marketplace, asin, month, title, source, week_tag, is_current, bazhuayu_mapping_id, bazhuayu_task_id, bazhuayu_task_name, bazhuayu_raw_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{p.marketplace}, #{p.asin}, #{p.month}, #{p.title}, #{p.source}, #{p.weekTag}, #{p.isCurrent}, #{p.bazhuayuMappingId}, #{p.bazhuayuTaskId}, #{p.bazhuayuTaskName}, #{p.bazhuayuRawJson}, #{p.createdAt}, #{p.updatedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = COALESCE(VALUES(title), title), source = VALUES(source), week_tag = VALUES(week_tag), is_current = VALUES(is_current), bazhuayu_mapping_id = VALUES(bazhuayu_mapping_id), bazhuayu_task_id = VALUES(bazhuayu_task_id), bazhuayu_task_name = VALUES(bazhuayu_task_name), bazhuayu_raw_json = VALUES(bazhuayu_raw_json), deleted = 0, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.sellersprite_raw_json IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.sellersprite_raw_json) != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS enriched FROM premium_products p ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%x-W%v') AS week, COUNT(*) AS count, MIN(DATE(created_at)) AS startDate, MAX(DATE(created_at)) AS endDate FROM premium_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND deleted = 0 AND title IS NOT NULL AND sellersprite_raw_json IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sellersprite_raw_json) != '' AND created_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC

SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(node_label_path, ':', 1)) AS category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM premium_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND deleted = 0 AND title IS NOT NULL AND sellersprite_raw_json IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sellersprite_raw_json) != '' AND node_label_path IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(node_label_path, ':', 1)) != '' GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC, category ASC

SELECT MIN(id) AS id, marketplace, seller_name AS sellerName, MIN(seller_id) AS sellerId, COUNT(*) AS productCount FROM premium_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND deleted = 0 AND title IS NOT NULL AND sellersprite_raw_json IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sellersprite_raw_json) != '' AND seller_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(seller_name) != '' GROUP BY marketplace, seller_name ORDER BY productCount DESC, seller_name ASC LIMIT 1000

SELECT asin FROM premium_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND deleted = 0 AND sellersprite_raw_json IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sellersprite_raw_json) != '' AND asin IN
#{asin}
